title: [plugin-dashboard] DashboardGridLayout has no legacy-widget fallback — a retired inline-analytics widget renders a silent blank chart where DashboardRenderer shows the rebind prompt
body:
Filed by the PM from the #4600 measure seat's report (§1 secondary finding; OQ1 ruled A). Duplicate-searched: no open issue mentions `DashboardGridLayout` at filing time.

## The defect

The framework#3320 retirement gave `DashboardRenderer` a legacy sentinel: a widget carrying the retired inline-analytics shape (top-level `object` + `categoryField`/`aggregate`, and the pivot family) selects the `LEGACY_RETIRED_WIDGET_SCHEMA` placeholder (`DashboardRenderer.tsx:142-155`, sentinel read at `:549`, pivot family at `:703-709`) — a visible "This widget uses a retired data format. Edit it to bind a dataset." tile with a rebind affordance.

`DashboardGridLayout` — a SEPARATE exported surface used by `DashboardWithConfig` / editable dashboards — has NO such sentinel. A legacy widget falls through to the static-data branch with `data: []` (`DashboardGridLayout.tsx:215-225`), i.e. a **silent blank chart**. That is the exact outcome the retirement's own test header says must not happen, and it is worse than the pre-retirement state for the user: no chart, no diagnostic, no path to fix.

## Blast radius

Editable dashboards (`DashboardWithConfig` consumers) rendering any stored dashboard authored before the retirement. `DashboardRenderer`'s own path is fine — the two surfaces just disagree.

## Fix shape

Give `DashboardGridLayout` the same legacy detection and the same placeholder (share the sentinel/placeholder rather than hand-copying it — one detector, two consumers), with a red-first pin mirroring `DashboardRenderer.legacyRetired.test.tsx`'s 4-positive/2-negative structure on the GridLayout surface. Must-not-change: dataset widgets, `options.data` provider config (a DIFFERENT, live surface — see the #4600 measurement's do-not-conflate note), and static-data widgets keep rendering.

Refs #4600 (measurement, comment 5287946890), framework#3320.
